data.title: Sickness benefit (Krankengeld) rejected from 12 January 2026
data.summary: Muster BKK wrote on 27 January 2026 that your sickness benefit (Krankengeld) is suspended because your incapacity for work was reported late. It will only pay from 22 January 2026.
data.explanation: Your health insurer says your incapacity certificate arrived on 22 January 2026, more than a week late, so your sickness benefit is suspended (§ 49 Abs. 1 Nr. 5 SGB V) and paid only from 22 January 2026. You may decide to file an objection (Widerspruch), in writing or recorded in person at Muster BKK; the app shows the deadline. If you do not object in time, the decision becomes final. If you have proof you reported on time, include it. A social advice centre or lawyer can help.

remedy.form_text: schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK
remedy.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK erhoben werden.

items.action: File an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person with Muster BKK if you disagree.
items.consequence: The decision becomes final if you do not object in time.
items.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK erhoben werden.
